text: Ask the assistant to explain how to make a cup of tea in three short steps.

expectation.description: A recorded assistant text response contains the requested three-step explanation.

text: Ask the assistant a short question and listen to its spoken answer.

expectation.description: A recorded audio response contains non-empty spoken output for the question.

text: Ask the assistant to tell you which files are in the current folder.

expectation.description: A recorded tool invocation lists the current folder with the requested arguments.

text: Describe the red apple in the image attached to this request.

expectation.description: A recorded image interaction contains a description grounded in the supplied picture.
